reviewSummary.stopDiscipline: BLOCKED BY ONE CURRENT-SCOPE CONTRACT GAP

priorFindingConvergence.reviewerDecision: 038 correctly requires package/current lifecycle-state equality with both sides non-terminal prepared|resumed; the original prepared-package/resumed-current counterexample is rejected.

findings.title: Exact Result admission does not bind ActionPackage to the exact current Run occurrence
findings.observation: 038 treats the existing Run occurrence as the execution-correlation identity and checks Result.runId == package.runId, but admission compares the package to CurrentAction only by semantic ActionIdentity and lifecycle state. CurrentAction carries no Run occurrence, so the package itself is not proven to be the package for the current occurrence.
findings.counterexample: A reviewer package for 20260826-037-review-explore is prepared and that occurrence later completes. After an intervening revise-explore, a new review-explore occurrence 20260826-039-review-explore becomes current in prepared state. The stale 037 package and a 037-linked Result have the same review-explore ActionIdentity, reviewer role and prepared state as the new current Action, so every admission invariant listed by 038 passes even though package.runId != exact current Run id.
findings.impact: The contract claims exact package/current-Action admission but cannot distinguish two real occurrences of the same Standard Action across the Author/Reviewer revision loop. A prior occurrence can therefore be accepted against a later current occurrence unless another later layer invents an unstated check.
findings.requiredRevision: Bind ActionPackage to the exact current Run occurrence as well as the exact current Action identity/state. Reuse the existing RunOccurrence/runId; require package.runId (or package.occurrence) to equal the exact current Run occurrence supplied by the execution boundary before Result admission. Add a negative proof for prior review-explore occurrence versus later review-explore occurrence with matching identity/state. Do not introduce PackageId/ResultId, nonce/replay registry, locking, Policy, scheduler or multi-Agent infrastructure.
